senses.en_definition: A coin made of metal, such as copper or silver; historically, a copper coin used during the colonial period.
A cent, in certain northern Malay dialects, used for amounts from one to nine and eleven to nineteen.

messages.en: I'm running low on money. Let's just cook at home.
Sounds good. I've got eggs and noodles—enough for both of us.

messages.en: I'm ready. Shall we head to the night market now?
Hang on, let me feed the cat first. Then we can head out.

senses.en_definition: The world; the earth and everything on its surface.
Life in this world; a person's experience or circumstances of life.
The people of the world collectively; the international community.
A particular field of activity, interest, or professional life.
A particular region or society; the wider society beyond one's immediate surroundings.

messages.en: Seeing your photos from Japan makes me want to travel around the world too. I just don't have enough money yet.
Let's start with somewhere closer to home. Let's save up and go to Thailand together next year.
